name: AI Chips & Data Centres Daily
tagline: The silicon, the buildings and the power behind AI.
description: AI Chips & Data Centres Daily covers the physical layer of artificial intelligence. Every day: the accelerators and systems that shipped, with their specifications; the data centres that were announced, broke ground or switched on, with megawatts and locations; the grid, generation and cooling constraints that decide where compute can go; the memory, packaging and foundry capacity underneath it; and the export rules around it. One engineering teardown a day explains a mechanism properly. Numbers first, sources named, never hype.
